description: Visualize complex cost-benefit scenarios and prioritize decarbonization strategies. The essential MACC tool for Sustainability, ESG, and Strategic Planning in Power BI. The Marginal Abatement Cost Curve (MACC) visual for Power BI is designed to solve a specific analytical challenge: visualizing the relationship between the volume of an initiative (width) and its cost-efficiency (height) simultaneously. While standard Power BI charts struggle with variable-width bars, our MACC visual makes it effortless to plot complex economic and environmental data on a single canvas. 1. What this visual offers Sustainability and Finance teams often struggle to communicate the economic impact of their climate strategies. Standard bar charts cannot display two metrics (e.g., Carbon Savings and Cost per Ton) on the axes required for a true feasibility analysis. The Challenge: Users resort to static Excel screenshots or complex workaround coding to show which projects save money (negative cost) versus those that require investment. The Solution: This visual automates the sorting and rendering of variable-width blocks, allowing you to instantly identify the "low-hanging fruit" in your strategy. 2. Who is this for? This visual is tailored for professionals balancing impact with budget: Sustainability & ESG Managers: To map out decarbonization pathways and report to stakeholders. Financial Analysts…
